definitions.explanation: Pain or stiffness in muscles, typically occurring after exercise or physical exertion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧{筋肉痛|きんにくつう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I got muscle soreness after exercising for the first time in a while.

examples.japanese: {筋肉痛|きんにくつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどくて→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}れない→上る：21460_noboru⟧。
examples.english: The muscle pain is so bad I can't climb stairs.

examples.japanese: {筋肉痛|きんにくつう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{二日後|ふつかご}→二日後：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Muscle soreness often comes one to two days after exercise.

examples.japanese: {筋肉痛|きんにくつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{和|やわ}らげる→和らげる：07897_yawarageru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ストレッチ→ストレッチ：05239_sutorecchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
MEDICAL/HEALTH TERM:
{筋肉痛|きんにくつう} refers to muscle soreness, particularly the delayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS) that occurs after exercise.

CAUSES:
- ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧: After exercise
- ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: Exercise after a long break
- ⟦{筋|きん}トレ→筋トレ：04915_kintore⟧: Weight training
- ⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧: Mountain climbing

- {筋肉痛|きんにくつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: muscle pain lingers
- {筋肉痛|きんにくつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧: muscle pain goes away

In casual speech, people often joke about {筋肉痛|きんにくつう} being delayed as a sign of aging (⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧), though this is not scientifically accurate.
